record.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15569. Abstract summary: Test-time training (TTT) adapts a pretrained model to each prompt via parameter updates, improving accuracy under pretraining-to-test distribution shifts. Yet, its performance often suffers from instability and sensitivity to hyperparameters such as update steps and subspace. We explain this behavior through a decision-theoretic Out of scope: Test-time training for adaptation/accuracy, not efficiency.
record.title: A Decision-Theoretic View of Test-Time Training: When, How Far, and Which Directions to Adapt
